NAME:
   Assh - An SSH Client

USAGE:
   <BIN> [global options] command [command options] [arguments...]

VERSION:
   v1.0.4-20230322

COMMANDS:
   version    
   account    Set the data crypto key (password)
   ls         Print all servers list
   search     (New) Search the server name
   info       Print the server information
   set        Add/Modify the server
   mv         Move/Rename Server Name
   rm         Remove Server
   login      login server or exec remote server command
   bc         batch remote command execution
   push       sftp push file to remote server
   pull       sftp pull file from remote server
   keygen     ssh keygen
   sync       synchronized data to the cloud storage
   export     
   import     
   upgrade    
   ping       
   proxy      assh proxy -d local port -i local hostname
   hostproxy  assh prots -h remote host -p remote port -d local port -i local host [hostname]
   help, h    Shows a list of commands or help for one command

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   -H value       server host
   -p value       bind address port (default: 0)
   -l value       login name
   -P value       login password
   -k value       automatic login public key
   -c value       run command
   --log value    log file path
   --llv value    log level
   --help, -h     show help
   --version, -v  print the version
